Arrivals

For Cristene,
with love

Est.
Today

Cristene, Happy birthday! I hope today feels like one of those pink-and-gold sunsets you love so much — the kind you'd stop everything just to watch a little longer. You're always chasing the next view, the next place, the next horizon, and honestly, that's one of my favorite things about you. This year I hope you get to see more sunsets, pet more cats along the way, and stamp your passport a few more times. I put this little page together because I wanted you to have something made just for you, the way you make ordinary places feel a little more special just by being there. Wishing you a year as warm as golden hour and as soft as a cat curled up in the sun.

— with love, always

Birthday wishes for you

Wish 01

May every sunset this year stop you in your tracks, just like your favorites always do.

Wish 02

May you find a cat to befriend in every new place you visit.

Wish 03

May your passport (and your heart) fill up with places that feel like home.

Wish 04

May this year of tourism school lead you exactly where you're meant to go.

Wish 05

May you always be as loved as you deserve to be. Happy birthday, Cristene.
